title: CurrentRefinedValues widget
body:
Another question about the currentRefinementsList, is it possible to edit the item template a bit more? 

We've added a cross icon and we only want to have that cross icon clickable.

comments.body:
Hi @Maaark,

That is not currently doable sadly for now. We have proposals to allow deep control over the rendering of every widgets but it's not yet ready.

For now I would keep the whole line clickable. Even on a UX side it's always very tricky to force people to click a very specific area (cross) instead of a much larger one.
